work_type: Item, profile, lot, shipment, and date-field matching
notes: P004 can perform a narrow comparison when records are explicitly identified; P008 can verify physical lot/date evidence.

work_type: Required MRL calculation, Remaining Life calculation, date comparison, and pass/fail classification
notes: The calculation is ceil(45 × 0.65) = 30 required days and 2026-10-07 minus 2026-09-10 = 27 actual days. A person or model may explain but should not be the sole reasonable calculator.

work_type: Temperature-limit comparison and count of out-of-range readings
notes: Compare each product reading to a maximum of 41°F; do not average readings.

work_type: Physical receiving chronology, evidence sufficiency, expanded sampling, RER, and hold execution
notes: P008 is the strongest persona fit. P004 may summarize chronology but lacks independent specialist receiving judgment.

work_type: Freshness-versus-safety interpretation and evaluation of the employee recall claim
notes: P007 is the strongest human fit. P004 may help gather facts but should not settle the technical distinction from memory.

work_type: Technical time/temperature risk assessment and selection among continued hold, restricted disposition, release, or rejection
notes: Reserved to the Director Q&R or delegated Q&R authority. P007 holds this authority; P004 and P008 do not.
Only Director Q&R or delegated Q&R authority may release the technical temperature hold.

work_type: Approval of an R3 non-safety short-date Freshness Exception
notes: Requires both Merchandising Manager and Director Q&R; no FE exists initially. If promotion or material supply commitment were implicated, Procurement Manager would also be required.
P004 is useful for coordination after verified conclusions are supplied; P007 owns technical conclusions; P008 owns receiving facts.
